happyPath.summary: Fresh-session replay (dasomel/openforge#54, 2026-10-04) selected the skill from its description, then audited every SSH invocation site against the Workflow: CommandRunner is the only production process site, push_connection_options carries StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new on all three ssh.rs paths, and the kubeconfig.rs BatchMode site inherits it from the generated -F config. The real local ssh binary tests (--ignored) passed. No source change was needed, so nothing was reverted.

edgeCase.summary: Removed StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new from push_connection_options in ssh.rs; the repository's own unit tests failed with a real nonzero exit (3 failed, cargo exit 101), then the change was reverted and the suite passed again (222 passed, exit 0).

deterministicChecks.command: cd src-tauri && cargo test --all-features -- --ignored real_process_receives real_ssh_binary_parses

unverified: No real SSH/k3s/Kubernetes target was available, so no live connect/bootstrap/kubeconfig-fetch evidence was gathered; only the local ssh binary argv/config-parse tests ran.
The ca_trust real-keychain ignored test was not run, and the ignored real-process ssh test was not re-run under the mutation.
Activation was assessed in a single-skill repository, so it does not show the skill winning against similar skills.
